newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs unchanged at 170 in the week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs unchanged at 170 in the week.

text.p: There were 170 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of June 6, unchanged from the period ending May 30, Offshore Data Services said Monday.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 179, was unchanged at 95.0 percent.
The number of working rigs in the European/Mediterranean area was up five at 112 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 109, a utilization rate also unchanged at 97.3 pct.
The European/Mediterranean was higher because of a change in the counting of rigs in the region.
The worldwide rig count was unchanged at 578 out of a total fleet of 605, with a utilization rate up from 95.4 percent at 95.5 percent.
